card.name: The phrase per se
card.fires_on: The word "se" (or "say") completing the Latin phrase "per se" after "per", in legal and academic prose. Also fires weakly on a few word endings like "-ans" or "-its".

modes.label: per se
modes.description: The ending of "per se" meaning "in itself", often in a negation such as "not a law per se".
modes.example: Not a Federal employment discrimination law per<< se>>.

modes.label: Odd word endings
modes.description: Final pieces of unusual words, such as slogans or plural noun endings.
